{{Top|leg}}
A '''blaster cannon energizer''' was part of the weapons systems of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. The energizer was located under the chin of the command section, between the forward facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
